command_text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
: "${GOAL2R_STAGE_P1:?set the absolute P1 directory of the clean staged export}"
: "${GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL:?set a new absolute build journal path}"
: "${GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL:?set a new absolute run journal path}"
: "${GOAL2R_CAPTURE_S:?set one of 8,16,24,64,128}"
: "${GOAL2R_CAPTURE_OPT:?set one of O0,O1,O2,O3}"
case "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL" in /*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
case "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL" in /*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
case "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_S" in 8|16|24|64|128) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
case "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_OPT" in O0|O1|O2|O3) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
stage_dir=$(realpath "$GOAL2R_STAGE_P1")
if [ "$stage_dir" = "$(pwd -P)" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'A separate clean staged export is required.' >&2
    exit 2
fi
cd "$stage_dir"
test ! -e "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL"
test ! -e "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL"
test "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL" != "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL"
test ! -e .cache/final-capture-build
mkdir -p .cache
python3 -B - <<'SOURCE_CHECK'
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
expected={'src/autotuner.py': 'e3a563264994f4875da955ad87ff4ce1dd0c6c180aad3da750e1ae7d5beb02ec', 'src/matrix_multiplication.c': 'aad89170e8d0ca80c1dbc8dc1d8d5e69bab354af86128021be163c91e5a72b50'}
for name, value in expected.items():
    assert sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == value, f'source changed: {name}'
SOURCE_CHECK
build_command=(taskset -c 0 python3 -B src/autotuner.py build --target src/matrix_multiplication.c
    --opts O0,O1,O2,O3 --compile-timeout 60 --cache-dir .cache/final-capture-build
    --protocol evidence/protocol_goal2r.json --output "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL")
printf '$'; printf ' %q' "${build_command[@]}"; printf '\n'
"${build_command[@]}" > .cache/final-capture-build.cli.json
python3 -B - "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_BUILD_JOURNAL" <<'BUILD_SUMMARY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines()]
metadata=rows[0]['metadata']
assert metadata['target']['n']==4096
builds=[row for row in rows if row['type']=='build']
assert [row['opt'] for row in builds]==['O0','O1','O2','O3']
print(metadata['target']['compiler']['version'].splitlines()[0])
for row in builds:
    assert row['status']=='ok' and row['cached'] is False
    assert row['compile']['returncode']==0
    assert row['flags']==['-std=c11','-Wall','-Wextra','-'+row['opt']]
    print('gcc '+' '.join(row['flags'])+'  exit=0  cached=false')
BUILD_SUMMARY
run_command=(taskset -c 0 python3 -B src/autotuner.py run --target src/matrix_multiplication.c
    --s "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_S" --opt "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_OPT" --repeats 1 --mode benchmark
    --timeout 1200 --compile-timeout 60 --cache-dir .cache/final-capture-build
    --protocol evidence/protocol_goal2r.json --output "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL")
printf '$'; printf ' %q' "${run_command[@]}"; printf '\n'
"${run_command[@]}" > .cache/final-capture-run.cli.json
python3 -B - "$GOAL2R_CAPTURE_RUN_JOURNAL" <<'RUN_SUMMARY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines()]
metadata=rows[0]['metadata']
assert metadata['target']['n']==4096 and metadata['target']['kernel_clock']=='CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW'
starts=[row for row in rows if row['type']=='measurement_start']
measurements=[row for row in rows if row['type']=='measurement']
assert len(starts)==len(measurements)==1
row=measurements[0]
summary=next(row for row in reversed(rows) if row['type']=='summary')
assert row['returncode']==0 and row['status']=='ok'
assert row['output_status']=='ok' and row['timing_status']=='ok' and row['score_eligible'] is True
assert summary['process_runs']==1 and summary['failed_runs']==summary['failed_trials']==0
print(row['stdout'],end='' if row['stdout'].endswith('\n') else '\n')
print('target exit=0  n=4096  processes=1  failed=0')
print(f"kernel RAW={row['kernel_s']:.6f} s; process RAW={row['process_raw_s']:.6f} s")
print(f"tuning window RAW={summary['tuning_raw_s']:.6f} s; clock={summary['primary_clock']}")
RUN_SUMMARY
terminal_command: P1 cold GCC builds and complete n4096 run
